subject: C31
required_fixes: R1 (high) — apps/desktop/src/v2/admin/review-sheet.tsx:47-53 only forgets secrets already marked held when close() runs, and has no unmount cleanup. Navigation can unmount a held rotation without ForgetSecret; closing after Version admission but before settlement also lets sync_changes subsequently retain the secret. This violates I6 and permits Reveal after the review has exited. Bind disclosure lifetime to the review in the core, including pending results, and retire it on every exit. Acceptance: held-result unmount, native-menu navigation, and close-before-delayed-issuance all leave no recoverable secret; reopening shows Resumed and Reveal refuses.

R2 (high) — crates/desktop-core/src/authority/rotation_domain.rs:233-250 and authority/management_domain.rs:370-374 reconcile from insufficient evidence. Unknown issuance accepts any different key for the application, including a pre-existing key. Unknown removal treats page.complete as a whole-inventory assertion, although management.rs:384 defines it as the last page; reading a final page without an old key present on an earlier page falsely completes rotation and clears its reminder. Retain attempt-specific issuance identity/baseline and reconcile absence only through a complete inventory walk or equivalent authoritative detail. Acceptance: an unchanged inventory with two existing keys cannot confirm issuance, and a final page omitting an old key on an earlier page cannot set oldKeyRemovedAt or clear the reminder.

R3 (high) — crates/desktop-core/src/authority/rotation_domain.rs:292-315 emits issuedBy whenever the secret is held, including after acknowledgeDeployment changes the stage to acknowledged. packages/desktop-contracts/src/client.ts:544 rejects issuedBy on every stage except issued, invalidating the entire ShellSnapshot. The visible Application updated action can therefore stop frontend observations before the secret is revealed or forgotten. Make the native transition and wire invariant agree while preserving secret retirement. Acceptance: issue a key, acknowledge without Reveal, and parse the actual emitted snapshot successfully; removal and subsequent snapshots remain usable.

R4 (high) — apps/desktop/src/v2/admin/review-sheet.tsx:44-45,98-109 hides the workbench for every settled rotation operation, but renders neither Applied nor an error when Version was accepted and its readback failed, stopped, was incomplete, or found nothing. rotation_settled records no rotation in these Completed cases without current/new_key, leaving an essentially empty sheet, potentially with a held secret. Preserve an explicit issuance-unconfirmed state and a usable reconciliation path without automatic reissuance. Acceptance: exercise each accepted-write/unconfirmed-readback case through the production flow and show the outcome, safe secret disposition, and actionable reconciliation.

R5 (high) — apps/desktop/src/v2/admin/review-sheet.tsx:64-67,125-150 classifies any Completed+Absent result as a successful removal even for Create/Update, and any Found result as live without accounting for the requested action or failure. Its reconciliation button always reads apiKeys, including for an unknown topic/profile/DLP change, and does not display that read's result. Make success action-specific and reconcile the actual reviewed resource, presenting what was established without replay. Acceptance: Update+Absent never shows green Removed, unconfirmed topic Update reads the topic and exposes its readback, and rejected/unknown outcomes cannot become success merely from a readback enum.

R6 (medium) — apps/desktop/src/v2/admin/administration.tsx:29-30,123-146 does not implement the advertised per-tab contracts. Every Red Team tab renders the same aggregate RedTeamPanel; every available Model/skill tab renders the same combined ModelsPanel. Gateway changes remain in GatewayView's independent inline ChangeWorkbench/ChangeResults path, with hard-coded actions/labels and no requireTyped or review-exit secret cleanup. Runtime capabilities likewise still come from CREATE/itemChanges, with AdminInventory used chiefly for labels. Connect each tab to its specified read surface and consume the inventory's admitted actions through the v2 review flow, preserving Gateway draft/workspace behavior. Acceptance: populated fixtures for every product/tab show the prescribed content and exact actions; Gateway keys retain in-place Rotate only and use typed confirmation plus correct secret disposal.

R7 (medium) — apps/desktop/src/features/administration/administration-view.tsx:330-365 still renders only Name/ID/Details. No shared topic relationship inventory or Used by presentation exists for profiles/topics, and the key table neither refreshes after issuance nor marks the old key Replace after deployment; the retained rotation-issued screenshot still lists only the old key. Implement the required domain-aware tables. Acceptance: profile/topic relationships derive from one inventory, and after Version readback both keys are visible with the old key distinctly marked until removal.

R8 (medium) — apps/desktop/src/features/runtime/runtime-view.tsx:419-421 removes topic_violation from both prompt and response detections, while crates/desktop-core/src/scanning.rs:283-307 populates topics only from prompt fields. A response-only topic violation previously visible in detections now disappears or is contradicted by the prompt's clear/unreported topic state. Preserve independently labelled response topic results or retain that response flag until represented. Acceptance: response-only topic-violation fixtures remain visible alongside unrelated enabled detectors, with prompt and response outcomes distinguished.

R9 (medium) — apps/desktop/src/v2/admin/rotation-panel.tsx:32 has no status live region, and its Verdict spans do not provide one. Issuance, acknowledgement, and removal completion replace content silently, contrary to DESIGN-V2 section 8's review-apply announcement requirement. Provide an appropriate persistent status announcement driven by observed stage changes. Acceptance: component and native accessibility checks establish an announced issuance/removal result without moving focus or announcing stale tenant state.
